comment.body: Thanks for the exact error and installation details. This can occur when Settings cannot communicate with the MWB process; the message alone does not identify which IPC check failed. Please reproduce once, then comment `/bugreport` and attach the newly generated diagnostic ZIP immediately afterward. We will compare it with #50795; please do not disable peer verification or mix executables from different releases.

judgment.rationale: Use the existing MWB settings-sync investigation rather than create a competing code fix from the generic error. A fresh diagnostic archive distinguishes peer-verification rejection from endpoint startup or other IPC failures. No trust bypass or mixed-release executable replacement is recommended.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the immediate post-reproduction diagnostic archive and route a confirmed matching failure to issue 50795.
evidence: PowerToys 0.102.3001 from Microsoft Store reports a pairing load/update error after New key or refresh.
The report supplies build, install-scope and non-elevated state, but no diagnostic archive.
The newest reply supplies another screenshot and says the symptom started after the last update, but supplies no diagnostic archive or failure-specific IPC evidence.

inferences: A settings-sync/IPC failure is plausible; matching signer-verification failure is not confirmed for this installation.
initial_investigation: Read the complete current report, comments, labels, ownership and linked-work history.
MouseWithoutBordersViewModel.GetSettingsSyncHelperAsync verifies the peer before creating SettingsSync; SubmitNewKeyRequestAsync uses that endpoint.
Read primary issue 50795 and the supplied signature-rejection evidence in 51666. Those establish a known matching symptom class, not that every New key failure has that cause.
Read the new screenshot-bearing reply. It does not answer the specific diagnostic gap or justify treating the suspected trust failure as proven on this installation.
Reassessed the complete current issue discussion and timeline, including the latest maintainer labels. Label changes alone do not satisfy unanswered evidence requests or prove a repair.
issue_context.summary: MWB Settings cannot load or update pairing; the screenshot/error alone does not establish why.

fix_assessment.rationale: Existing investigation 50795 covers the suspected failure class; this is not a claim that a shipped fix exists or this report is a proven duplicate.
